title: Add summarize-goals activity and register goal_summary shape
description: Adds a new activity "summarize-goals" which invokes the "goal_summary" resolver. Also, registers the "goal_summary" shape in discovery-registration.ts to make it discoverable.

changes.anchor:
shapes: 'conceptDbReachable' in config && config.conceptDbReachable === false
      ? config.discovery.shapes.filter((s: string) => !['concept_usage_record', 'concept_search_by_source', 'concept_select_for_prompt'].includes(s))
      : config.discovery.shapes,
